Method of Attack: Malicious package with same name as official PyTorch-nightly 'torchtriton' library
Collects system fingerprinting info (IP address, username, current working directory)
Steals sensitive data including /etc/resolv.conf, /etc/hosts, /etc/passwd, first 1,000 files in $HOME, $HOME/.gitconfig, $HOME/.ssh/*
Uploads stolen data via encrypted DNS queries to h4ck.cfd domain using wheezy.io DNS server
Contains obfuscated Linux ELF binary with anti-VM techniques
Reads .bash_history to capture user terminal commands
Attack Vector: Dependency confusion via PyPI precedence over official repository
Indicators of Compromise: SHA256 hash of malicious 'triton' ELF binary: 2385b29489cd9e35f92c072780f903ae2e517ed422eae67246ae50a5cc738a0e
